notes: This pins Aether to its currently reviewed Etalon lock source. QualiaDB currently uses another revision; cross-repository alignment remains a separate release gate.
The check reads the full Cargo.lock and dependency declarations, including optional and target-specific dependencies. It does not compute Cargo's active feature/target graph.
No compatibility shim is approved at this pin. Enabling an exception requires inspecting its actual package version at the reviewed revision; the newer Etalon shim is version 30.0.0, not 0.0.2.

Hypermedia is pinned by actual locked commit, independent of the mutable branch name. Only the three attributed vendor manifests listed above are approved local overrides; canonical opt-in consumers have their own source verification.
